source_en: Heads or tails? Habit. Bidzina Chkhonia. Cards, mostly.
I've been timing this checkpoint. The variance is bigger than you'd think.
There's a book on how long new officers last. I hold a position.
The Metropol, before it closed. Now a basement. Lower stakes, worse people.
You have a tell, Officer. I won't say [[whisper:which eye]]. But I'd bet on it.
How long did the last one last?
Nineteen days. I had him at twenty. Cost me a good watch.
So is half this city now. You'll want to pick which half you enforce.
Heads. Always heads lately. That worries me.
